annotations.title: Read and save your resume (CV, Lebenslauf)

description: Use this when the user is looking for a job (Stelle) and shares their resume, CV or Lebenslauf, or wants to change the one on file. Two steps with the same tool. First call it with freitext (the resume as text), pdf (a PDF, Base64) or datei (an attached PDF): the resume is only **read**, the extracted fields come back under `entwurf`, and nothing is saved yet — except that a PDF is kept as the user’s one resume document and replaces the previous one. Show the user these fields and let them correct whatever was misread. Then call this tool again with felder: only that saves the resume, and the first time it also selects five job matches — call get_job_matches to show them. Never save fields the user has not seen. Each user has exactly one resume; saving again updates it and brings no new job matches — those come only from refresh_job_matches. Jobroulette covers IT, sales, operations, engineering, marketing, finance and legal, and HR: if the saved resume carries `imZuschnitt` false, tell the user that their resume does not look like any of these fields and the matches will therefore probably not fit them. Before the first resume, the user has to consent to its processing themselves on the Jobroulette website; until then this tool fails with einwilligung_fehlt, quoting the consent text and the page where the user gives it. Show both to the user — you cannot consent on their behalf. Exactly one of freitext, pdf, datei, felder per call. Scope: cv:schreiben.

datei.description: The resume as an attached PDF file.

felder.description: The resume field by field, as the user has confirmed it — only this saves it. Required: job title, years of experience, at least one skill.

freitext.description: The resume as text, as the user wrote or pasted it. It is only read, not saved.

pdf.description: The resume as a PDF with a text layer, Base64-encoded, at most 5 MiB. Scans are refused. It is only read, not saved.

wunsch.description: What the user is looking for that the resume does not say, in their own words, at most 280 characters — for example "remote only, full-time, from March". Workload, contract type, workplace, locations, seniority, industries, minimum salary, company size and excluded employers are read from it. Only together with felder; without it, the previous one stays.

name: upload_resume

imZuschnitt.description: Whether the resume falls within the fields Jobroulette covers: IT; sales and business development; operations, strategy and projects; engineering and R&D outside IT; marketing, content and design; finance, legal and compliance; HR and recruiting. If false, tell the user that their resume does not look like any of these fields and the job matches will therefore probably not fit them; they may continue anyway.

angelegt.description: After felder: the saved resume. With the first one, five job matches are ready; get_job_matches shows them. A changed resume does not change them; new ones come only from refresh_job_matches.

entwurf.description: After freitext, pdf or datei: the fields that were read. Nothing has been saved yet. Show them to the user, let them correct them, then call again with felder.

title: Read and save your resume (CV, Lebenslauf)
